global.inference: OLS slope; HAC covariance; Student t with n minus full design rank df
global.fdr: BH across all pairs/lags and both fits; unavailable tests occupy p=1 slots
global.sample: Identical longest contiguous finite overlap for both fits; ties choose earliest
global.climate: rni: mean of 12 closed Jan-Dec monthly Relative Nino3.4 values; dmi: 12-month Jan-Dec mean
global.lag_controls: Response-year climate plus predictor-year climate for positive lags
global.baseline: Shared fixed time/regime nuisance basis; not replication of separately detrended original results
global.interpretation: Historical association sensitivity; no causal, prospective, or prophetic attribution
global.family_separation: Global and regional panels have distinct pre-existing hypotheses and observation units; no pooled significance claim
global.confidence_intervals: 95% pointwise HAC slope intervals; not simultaneous or selection-adjusted
